citations.quote: In Study AG221-C-001, patients were selected based on detection of an IDH2 mutation in the local laboratory, and the results were confirmed by testing in a central laboratory using the Abbott RealTime IDH2™ mutation assay, which identifies the following mutations: R140Q, R140L, R140G, R140W, R172K, R172M, R172G, R172S, and R172W. It was determined that a device to select patients for therapy would be required for safe use of this drug when marketed. The applicant cross-referenced PMA P170005 for the Abbott RealTime IDH2™ mutation assay.
